item.title: EPH Invest signs binding deal to integrate Todini Costruzioni Generali group via in-kind share contribution
item.description: Binding agreements signed to integrate the Todini Costruzioni Generali group into EPH Invest via an in-kind contribution from Fin.Mar. Holding. Assets to be
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Binding agreements signed to integrate the Todini Costruzioni Generali group into EPH Invest via an in-kind contribution from Fin.Mar. Holding. Assets to be contributed include holdings in Fin.Mar. Holding Due, Mattei Energia, IDIT Holding, including their subsidiaries. FMH indicated a total fair value of at least EUR 180 million, with a final valuation to be set by an independent expert. EPH plans a reserved capital increase expected to leave FMH with 83% of EPH’s share capital post-transaction. Todini’s order book includes about EUR 261.5 million in Italy, with contracted overseas work of about EUR 1.96 billion. item.title: Metaguest.AI completes corporate continuance to Ontario from Alberta
item.description: Metaguest completed a corporate continuance, shifting its corporate jurisdiction from Alberta to Ontario. The move aligns the company’s legal domicile with
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Metaguest completed a corporate continuance, shifting its corporate jurisdiction from Alberta to Ontario. The move aligns the company’s legal domicile with its Ontario-based operations. Ontario jurisdiction supports a strategy to pursue provincial government funding programs, alongside applicable federal programs. Governance now falls under the Business Corporations Act (Ontario). No change to business operations, management, share capital, or the CSE listing; shareholders do not need to act. item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Graham Partners portfolio company DecisionPoint Technologies acquired 5th Wave Mobile Technology, expanding its enterprise mobility and edge-technology platform. August transactions mark DecisionPoint’s fourth and fifth add-on acquisitions under Graham ownership, targeting broader geographic coverage and deeper customer ties. item.title: CPS closes $80 million residual-interest securitization with 10.25% asset-backed notes
item.description: CPS closed an $80 million securitization of residual interests, issuing asset-backed notes with a 10.25% coupon. Notes secured by residual interests from se
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CPS closed an $80 million securitization of residual interests, issuing asset-backed notes with a 10.25% coupon. Notes secured by residual interests from securitizations issued April 2022 to April 2023. Collateral also includes an 80% interest in a majority-owned affiliate holding residual interests tied to securitizations issued July 2023 to April 2026. Proceeds used partly to fully repay higher-coupon residual interest financing notes issued in March 2024.
